mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1.0% in a month indicates contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 5.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals supply shock contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 5.0% and INDPRO declines by >0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals strong consumer demand, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.3% in a month indicates labor market overheating without supply capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and INDPRO declines > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >0.5% and INDPRO declines by >0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1.0% in a month signals strong consumer confidence and housing demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and HOUST rises by >1.0% in a month.
